title: Elliptic criticality versus Volterra memory in indirect chemotaxis cascades
summary: Indirect signal production is often treated as a higher-order variant of classical Keller-Segel chemotaxis, but its critical structure depends strongly on how the signal cascade is closed. This paper separates two asymptotic regimes of a two-stage signalling mechanism. In the parabolic--elliptic--elliptic limit, the chemoattractant is generated by the self-adjoint fourth-order operator $K_τ=(I-τΔ)^{-1}(I-Δ)^{-1}$.
